results.snippet:
BYD has been able to take advantage of South Korea's growing appetite for cheap EVs, said Lee Jae-il, a senior analyst at Eugene Investment & Securities. Petrol prices have surged almost 10% since the US-Israeli war on Iran started, but Hyundai and Kia focus mainly on premium EVs, offering only a few for under $30,000.

"The timing has worked particularly well for BYD," Lee said.
